description: Test suite for the CSIDriver strategy, including validation, preparation for create/update, and warnings, specifically for the Kubernetes CSI driver strategy implementation.

methods.name: getValidCSIDriver

methods.name: TestCSIDriverStrategy
methods.description: Tests validation and update logic of the CSIDriver strategy.

methods.name: TestCSIDriverPrepareForUpdate
